evals.prompt: /archive — I want to archive the current sprint and clean up completed stories.
evals.expected_output: Creates a timestamped archive directory in docs.local/prd-archive/ containing index.json, all story files, and progress.txt. Then removes completed stories (passes=true) while preserving pending and blocked stories. Resets the PRD index.

assertions.name: creates-timestamped-archive-directory
assertions.description: Creates an archive directory with a timestamp pattern (e.g., docs.local/prd-archive/20260307-HHMMSS/)

assertions.name: archives-before-cleanup
assertions.description: Creates the archive snapshot BEFORE removing any completed stories — safety-first approach

assertions.name: preserves-pending-and-blocked
assertions.description: Does NOT remove stories that are pending (passes=false) or in the blocked array — only completed stories get cleaned

assertions.name: resets-prd-index-after-cleanup
assertions.description: Updates the PRD index.json to reflect the remaining stories after cleanup (stats reset, completed array cleared)

assertions.name: uses-archive-scripts
assertions.description: Uses or references the skill's archive-snapshot.sh and/or cleanup-completed.sh scripts rather than implementing archive logic from scratch

evals.prompt: /archive — just take a snapshot, don't clean anything up.
evals.expected_output: Creates a snapshot-only archive without removing any stories. The full current PRD state is preserved in docs.local/prd-archive/ with timestamp. No stories are deleted or modified.

assertions.name: creates-snapshot-without-cleanup
assertions.description: Creates the archive snapshot but does NOT remove or modify any existing story files or the PRD index

assertions.name: archive-contains-full-state
assertions.description: Archive directory contains index.json, all story files (completed + pending + blocked), and progress.txt

assertions.name: no-stories-deleted
assertions.description: No story files are deleted from the working PRD directory — this is snapshot-only
